rows.text: A robed friar stops you. She carries a weighty brass scale — likely a follower of Talanton.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You're in no mood for justice or balance, ready to wave her off, but she raises the scale toward you before you can speak.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I walk in the world, spreading the word of Talanton's equilibrium. You may entrust a wish to this scale — place it upon one side, and if your wish is fulfilled, then the other side will bear a matching reward. Both shall be yours."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: If even Talanton's followers are resorting to mystical sales pitches, times must be rough. Then again... no harm in trying, right?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I want to become the richest person in Amphoreus.
Obtains 1 special Curio. After obtaining a large amount of Cosmic Fragment, this Curio can be used to obtain rewards
"I can already sense wealth gathering at one end of the scale. When the balance is restored, I will return to you." With a faint smile, the friar turns and walks away.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I want to become a member of the Council of Elders.
Obtains 1 special Curio. After activating a high-rating Equation, this Curio can be used to obtain rewards
"I can already sense power gathering at one end of the scale. When the balance is restored, I will return to you." With a faint smile, the friar turns and walks away.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I want to become a sage in the Grove of Epiphany.
Obtains 1 special Curio. After obtaining a high-rating Curio, this Curio can be used to obtain rewards
"I can already sense wisdom gathering at one end of the scale. When the balance is restored, I will return to you." With a faint smile, the friar turns and walks away.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I'm happy with who I am right now.
"You've passed up a golden opportunity, but perhaps your scale was already in perfect balance." The friar gives you a knowing nod of approval.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
